  (() => {
    const popup = document.getElementById('collection-atc-popup-template--22565002084409__main');

    if (!popup || popup.dataset.initialized === 'true') {
      return;
    }

    popup.dataset.initialized = 'true';

    const openPopup = () => {
      if (document.documentElement.classList.contains('collection-atc-popup-open')) {
        return;
      }
      popup.removeAttribute('hidden');
      document.documentElement.classList.add('collection-atc-popup-open');
    };

    const isPopupEligibleForm = (form) => {
      return form.classList.contains('product-card__quick-add-form--popup') || form.classList.contains('product-form--popup');
    };

    const getPopupCollectionIdFromForm = (form) => {
      const classList = Array.from(form.classList);
      const productCardClass = classList.find((className) => className.indexOf('product-card__quick-add-form--popup-collection-') === 0);

      if (productCardClass) {
        return productCardClass.replace('product-card__quick-add-form--popup-collection-', '');
      }

      const productFormClass = classList.find((className) => className.indexOf('product-form--popup-collection-') === 0);

      if (productFormClass) {
        return productFormClass.replace('product-form--popup-collection-', '');
      }

      return '';
    };

    const closePopup = () => {
      popup.setAttribute('hidden', '');
      document.documentElement.classList.remove('collection-atc-popup-open');
    };

    popup.querySelectorAll('[data-popup-close]').forEach((element) => {
      element.addEventListener('click', closePopup);
    });

    document.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape' && !popup.hasAttribute('hidden')) {
        closePopup();
      }
    });

    document.addEventListener('variant:add', (event) => {
      const submittedForm = event.target;

      if (!(submittedForm instanceof HTMLFormElement)) {
        return;
      }

      if (!isPopupEligibleForm(submittedForm)) {
        return;
      }

      const requestedCollectionId = getPopupCollectionIdFromForm(submittedForm);
      const popupCollectionId = popup.dataset.popupCollectionId || '';

      if (requestedCollectionId !== '' && popupCollectionId !== '' && requestedCollectionId !== popupCollectionId) {
        const matchingPopup = document.querySelector(`.collection-atc-popup[data-popup-collection-id="${requestedCollectionId}"]`);

        if (matchingPopup) {
          return;
        }
      }

      openPopup();
    });
  })();
</script>

    const originalBuyButton = section.querySelector('.product-info__buy-buttons button[type="submit"]');

    function updateStickyVisibility() {
      // Show sticky bar only after the original buy button has scrolled out above the viewport.
      const buttonRect = originalBuyButton.getBoundingClientRect();
      const shouldShowSticky = window.innerWidth < 1000 && buttonRect.bottom <= 0;

      stickyBar.classList.toggle('is-visible', shouldShowSticky);
    }

    updateStickyVisibility();
    window.addEventListener('scroll', updateStickyVisibility, { passive: true });

    // Also check on resize to disable on desktop
    window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
      if (window.innerWidth >= 1000) {
        stickyBar.classList.remove('is-visible');
        return;
      }

      updateStickyVisibility();
    });
  });
</script>
